components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary action for a visual region.
components.css: .ds-button { background: #16233F; color: #FFFFFF; height: 44px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 11px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: #BF4D52; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #BF4D52; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field with a clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #647084; font: 700 10px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(22,35,63,.16); border-radius: 3px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16233F; font: 400 14px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #BF4D52; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Rail
components.description: Persistent midnight-blue app navigation with an explicit current location.
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 248px; min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px; background: #16233F; } .ds-nav a { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.78); font: 700 11px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .11em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 #BF4D52; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Marker
components.description: A text-bearing state paired with a relationship-color station marker.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(22,35,63,.16); border-radius: 4px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16233F; font: 700 10px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-status i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 2px solid #43805A; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Dependency Route
components.description: Right-angle path with labeled relationships and an accessible text equivalent.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #16233F; font: 600 13px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-route i { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: none; border: 2px solid #BF4D52; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-route b { color: #BF4D52; font: 700 10px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-route span { border-bottom: 2px solid #BF4D52; padding-bottom: 3px; }

narrative.overview: CareSync borrows the disciplined linework of metropolitan wayfinding to make dependency paths legible. The product remains a familiar web application with explicit human review actions. Route notation supports the task; it never replaces navigation, controls, tables, or accessible text.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight-blue navigation and warm porcelain workspace.
Right-angle relationship routes with labels and text equivalents.

rules.name: The Named Route Rule
rules.body: Color never carries relationship meaning alone. Every route has a text label and accessible text equivalent.

dos: Do make policy names, active versions, and draft states the first dashboard read.
Do pair every relationship route with a visible label and text equivalent.
Do keep navigation and controls familiar to web users.
donts: Don't imply geographic distance or live transit service; the route is a dependency metaphor only.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate status or relationship.
Don't use decorative route graphics on pages without route data.
